findings.title: The tide table has no date, no example label and no height reference

location.description: the tide card heading and table (right of the hero on desktop and widescreen, under the button on tablet and phone)

findings.viewer_experience: A harbor master cannot tell whether these are live tides or a sample, or what level 4.8 m is measured from. That gap undercuts the headline promise of times you can stand behind.

current.value: heading 'Today at Porthmellin' with no date, no example label and no height reference near the table

findings.target: The card is labeled as an example of the page Tidewell posts, and shows a date and a height reference.
findings.fix_direction: Label the card as an example of the page Tidewell posts, and add the date and the height reference. Only the maker can supply the height reference (the level the heights are measured from), so the maker must supply it.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees an example label, a date and a height reference near the tide table in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The hero preview shows tides only and leaves blank space beside it

location.description: the narrow tide card and the white gap between it and the hero text on desktop and widescreen; the empty right third beside the hero on tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees a fragment of the product, not the page berth holders would check.

current.value: about 230 px of white between the hero text and a narrow card with four tide rows; on tablet the right 240 px beside the hero is empty

findings.target: The preview fills the right column and shows the whole posted page, using only rows for features the page already names. The tablet uses its full width or keeps two columns.
findings.fix_direction: Widen the preview to fill the right column and show the whole posted page, using only rows for the features the page already names (gate times, pontoon depth, notices). Let the tablet use its full width, or keep two columns there.
findings.source: Arnheim, Balance; unslop: empty hero visual

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees no wide blank gap between the hero text and the card in the desktop and widescreen viewports, a preview that shows more than tides, and no empty right third beside the hero in the tablet viewport.

findings.title: Nothing sets Tidewell beside the way offices post times now
findings.viewer_experience: The reader takes 'can stand behind' on trust.

current.value: no comparison with the office's current way of posting times

findings.target: One line or image compares Tidewell with the office's current way of posting times.
findings.fix_direction: Add one line or image that compares Tidewell with the office's current way of posting times. The maker must supply the comparison.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees one line or image that compares Tidewell with the office's current way of posting times in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The point headings are only slightly heavier than their body text

location.description: the three point headings below the hero

findings.viewer_experience: The three points read as one gray block.

current.value: 15 px, weight 500, same size as the 15 px body text

findings.target: The headings stand out from the body text by a little more weight or the darker text color, with no new type size.
findings.fix_direction: Give the headings a little more weight or the darker text color, without adding a new size.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees the point headings clearly set apart from their body text in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports, with type_sizes still 30, 19 and 15 px.

findings.title: The page ends with a blank lower band and no closing call to action

location.description: the blank band below the three points

findings.viewer_experience: The page stops at about y 585 and leaves the rest of the screen empty with nothing to do next.

current.value: page content ends at about y 585 of 800

findings.target: A closing call to action or a footer sits below the points.
findings.fix_direction: Repeat the button or add a footer below the points.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees a repeated button or a footer below the points in the desktop and widescreen viewports.
